findings.rationale: These exhaustive/reachability entry points seed exploration from Monitor::new's single default valuation, although concrete_initial_states establishes that unassigned init variables represent multiple permitted initial states. Violations, reachable expressions, action covers, and leadsTo responses that exist only from another initial valuation are therefore missed.

The refinement checker never inspects abs_step.violation. Monitor::step leaves state at the pre-state on an ensures, trans, invariant, type-bound, or partial-operation failure, so a mapped abstract action that fails while leaving the abstract state unchanged can be accepted; the later current_violation call cannot recover transition- or ensures-specific failures.

Every successful successor is enqueued without any deduplication or compact progress-state key. Cycles and multiple stuttering actions consequently generate one node per action sequence rather than per distinct semantic state; a two-action one-state model produces exponential work up to depth, especially when a response is missing.

The nonzero-divisor branches call div_euclid/rem_euclid directly. For i64::MIN and -1 these operations overflow and panic, bypassing RuntimeError despite the evaluator otherwise using checked integer arithmetic; a user expression can therefore crash the runtime.
